授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
社会基盤諸施設を支える地盤の力学のうち，地盤の破壊，地盤と構造物との相互作用についての基本的な考え方を身につける。地盤材料を対象としたモールの応力円と極の考え方の理解、地盤を構成する土要素のせん断強さの一般法則の理解，地盤の破壊現象の解釈ならびに土圧，支持力，斜面安定に関する解析法の基礎的知識を身につけ，これらを具体的な工学問題に適用するための素養を身につける。
This yeaｒ’s class will be done by on-line system (Teams system). Students who wish to take the course should register on Moodle.
https://moodle.s.kyushu-u.ac.jp/course/view.php?id=59869

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Soil mechanics relates to the study of the engineering behavior of soils, which is needed in the design of civil engineering structures. Examples of these structures include embankments, fills and cuts, earth retaining walls, building foundations, bridges, dams, roads, railroads, ports and airports and so on. This subject is concerned primarily with stability of soil structures and natural slope, which include the shear strength of soils under various drained conditions, Coulomb’s and Rankin’s earth pressure, bearing capacity of shallow foundation and slope stability.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Stress increment due to a load, Mohr’s stress circle and Pore, Shear strength, Earth pressure
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: There is no course requirement, however,  it is expected that students have already taken the credit of Soil Mechanics I(A),(B)
